claim: A standard isolated drive environment (spare port, copied DB) and a policy for cleaning up real GitHub PRs the drive opens should be provided, so reviewers do not improvise around the live :8010 Hub.

citations.quote: Provide a standard isolated drive environment, with a spare port and a copied DB, and a policy for cleaning up real GitHub PRs the drive opens.
Reviewers should not have to improvise around the live :8010 Hub.
